subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Carlos Ghosn's Golden Escape
description: One-minute skill: Carlos Ghosn's Golden Escape.

hook.text: The CEO of Nissan-Renault hid $80 million in compensation, then escaped Japan in a music box.

buildup.text: Carlos Ghosn allegedly underreported his pay for years and used company funds for personal expenses.

discovery.text: He was arrested in Tokyo in 2018 and placed under strict bail conditions.

twist.text: He fled Japan hidden inside an audio equipment case on a private jet — one of history's wildest escapes.

climax.text: He now lives in Lebanon, which has no extradition treaty with Japan. He's never faced trial.

punchline.text: He escaped trial inside a box. The case remains open.

quiz.question: How did Carlos Ghosn flee Japan?
options: He sailed on a private yacht
He was hidden inside audio equipment on a private jet
He crossed the border by car
